name: Incognito Dove Disguise Glasses
description: The classic Groucho gag — bushy brows, big fake nose, 'stache. Our paranoid dove's official disguise, now on your face. A joke about a serious problem: you shouldn't need a disguise to run errands.
fine_print: Novelty item. Costume use only — not PPE, not a privacy device.

name: IR-Reflective Privacy Glasses
description: Lenses and frames engineered to reflect and reduce near-infrared, the band many IR-based face-scan and night cameras rely on.
fine_print: Reduces IR-based capture under some conditions. Not a guarantee against all facial recognition, does nothing against bright-daylight 2D systems, and has no effect on license-plate readers. Results vary by device.

name: “FLOCK OFF” License Plate Frame
description: Say it every red light. Slim frame designed to sit clear of the characters, state name, and registration sticker — legal in all 50 states.
fine_print: Install so no part of the plate text is covered, per your state's rules.

name: FLOCK OFF Sticker Pack (5)
description: Weatherproof vinyl for laptops, water bottles, guitar cases, city-council parking meters (kidding). Spread the word.
fine_print: Not for use on license plates or plate frames.
